pass_gate: The evaluator moves a feature to passing only after its listed verification evidence succeeds.

features.behavior: Repository contains a runnable React 18/Vite frontend, Node API contract, and assessment notes.
features.verification: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
features.evidence: pnpm verify: typecheck passed, 11 tests passed, Vite build passed

features.behavior: A natural-language brief routes through distinct destination, itinerary, and budget agents and returns a synthesised plan.
features.verification: POST /api/plan in demo mode, then complete the browser walkthrough in README.md
features.evidence: curl SSE walkthrough: request -> Destination -> Itinerary -> Budget -> result; browser rebuilt the full plan after choosing a shortlist option, and the Varanasi contract test covers an option outside the demo catalog

features.behavior: Each completed request is persisted with route, agents/provider mode, status, destination, cost, and duration.
features.verification: Run two plans, GET /api/audit, and confirm both records contain the required fields
features.evidence: GET /api/audit after two plans returned persisted route, mode, status, destination, total, and duration fields

features.behavior: User sees loading/agent activity, actionable errors, agent contributions, budget status, and uncertainty notes.
features.verification: Browser walkthrough covers loading state, successful plan, and empty/invalid input
features.evidence: Browser walkthrough showed route progress, end-user plan sections, budget buffer, uncertainty note, actionable short-input alert, and a separate Operator view with redacted metrics and recent outcomes

features.behavior: Submission includes reproducible README, <=400-word decision note, <=300-word Azure architecture note, and deployment configuration.
features.verification: Manual review of README.md, DECISION_NOTE.md, ARCHITECTURE_NOTE.md, and package scripts
features.evidence: README.md, DECISION_NOTE.md, ARCHITECTURE_NOTE.md, .env.example, package scripts, and pnpm-workspace.yaml reviewed; https://zotefoam.vercel.app verified in production

features.behavior: A simple Operator role exposes a distinct, redacted operational metrics and request-log view.
features.verification: Open the app, run one plan, switch to ?role=operator, and confirm metrics, route mix, and recent outcomes are visible without prompts or provider payloads
features.evidence: Public browser verification showed Traveler plan -> Operator view with Requests=1, Recent request log, Route mix, and zero console errors
